patch_description: This candidate adopts the best-performing motif from prior runs: symmetry-grouped local rotations (pre- and post-RZ plus RY), a stable CZ lattice backbone, targeted parametrized CRZ couplings between center and its neighbors, and ZZZ three-qubit motif rotations aligned to the eight winning lines. Parameter sharing is used to enforce corner/edge/center symmetries within each block and to share a single ZZZ motif parameter across all winning lines (motivating motif discovery while keeping parameter count efficient). The block has 11 unique parameter keys (so N_PARAMS = 11 * N_UPLOADS * N_REPEATS = 66), which in past experiments yielded improved validation/test accuracy and a smaller generalization gap compared with the current program. The rest of the code (training loop, feature map, re-uploading, measurements, etc.) is unchanged; only ANSATZ_SPEC inside the EVOLVE block is modified.
